title: Micron Stock (MU) Falls 4.5% on TrendForce Memory Outlook (Nov 25)
summary: Micron stock (MU) fell 4.53% to $601.25 on Nov 25 after TrendForce said Chinese cloud firms cut 2027 memory orders. How MU traded and why.
body_markdown:
Memory and chip names also weakened.[Sandisk (SNDK)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/sndk/) dropped 5.57%,[Nvidia (NVDA)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) lost 3.91% and[TSMC (TSM)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/tsm/) declined 1.96%. At the close, Micron sat in a[drawdown](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/what-is-drawdown-meaning-risks-and-example/) of 52.09% from its 52-week high of $1,255.00, while still trading 171.21% above its 52-week low of $221.69.


## Why Micron Stock Fell


Financial media tied the drop to new signs of softer memory demand from China. According to[TrendForce](https://www.trendforce.com/presscenter/news/20261125-13321.html) , "Chinese CSPs have reduced their 2027 memory orders, putting downward pressure on the industry’s price outlook." The research firm said some Chinese cloud providers began scaling back their 2027 enterprise SSD procurement plans in mid-4Q26 amid concerns over GPU supply shortages, and that these reductions exceeded the additional orders placed by North American cloud providers.


TrendForce lowered its 2027 NAND Flash revenue forecast to $419.3 billion, representing 29% year-over-year growth, and trimmed its 2027 DRAM revenue forecast to $1.15 trillion, representing 69% growth. As reported by[The Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/11/25/why-micron-stock-just-dropped-again/) , the release came five days after an earlier TrendForce update said Chinese companies were cutting back on memory purchases, causing NAND spot prices to fall 20%.


Per[Schaeffer's Investment Research](https://www.schaeffersresearch.com/content/news/2026/11/25/micron-stock-plunges-after-downgrade-steep-pt-cut) , BNP Paribas also revised its view on Micron on Wednesday, warning that memory demand could peak sooner than expected and lead to oversupply. Schaeffer's added that the drop came as[AI stocks extended their recent sell-off](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-nvda-stock-news-november-25-2026/) , while[The Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/11/25/not-micron-not-broadcom-this-is-my-top-oversold-artificial-intelligence-ai-stock-to-buy-in-december/?source=iedfolrf0000001) wrote that the recent sell-off in the semiconductor sector has led to a sharp decline in Micron's shares.


## MU Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- TrendForce expects DRAM supply to remain tight throughout 2027, even after lowering its 2027 DRAM revenue forecast to $1.15 trillion.
- According to TrendForce, North American cloud providers quickly absorbed the server DRAM supply freed up by Chinese order cuts, keeping overall DRAM bit demand on a strong growth trajectory for 2027.
- The Motley Fool noted that NAND, the market where TrendForce sees oversupply, makes up only about a quarter of Micron's sales.


### Risks


- TrendForce expects the NAND Flash market to enter a downward pricing cycle as supply continues to expand, pushing overall contract prices lower.
- In DRAM, TrendForce projects quarterly contract price increases to narrow progressively, potentially leveling off in the second half of 2027.
- BNP Paribas warned that memory demand could peak sooner than expected and lead to oversupply, according to Schaeffer's.


Micron's next earnings report, its fiscal 2027 first-quarter results, is expected on Dec. 17, according to The Motley Fool; treat the date as an estimate until Micron confirms it.
